credits.software: This game uses the following software:
credits.licenses: The full license texts are in FACTORIA_NOTICES.txt, shipped with the game.
credits.art: Art: Kenney (Tiny Dungeon, Roguelike Caves and Dungeons), CC0. The moles, the beetles, the thief, the Mole King, the torches, the fog, the lift arrows, the cracks and the tint of the three strata are drawn for this game.
credits.sounds: Sound effects and music: made for this game with FactorIA's sound synthesiser and a small script, CC0.

options.title: Options
options.videoNote: Video settings apply when the game runs in its own window.
options.pressKey: {action}: press a key or button (Esc cancels)
options.playerPress: {action}: press a key or a button (Esc cancels)
options.holdModeToggle: press to start, press to stop
options.gameSpeedNote: A slower shift does not post to the boards.
options.accessNote: Ore and hazards also carry a shape, so they read without colour.

hud.lampLow: Your lamp is running low! Find oil or ride the lift up.
hud.liftWait: On the lift. Waiting for the others...
hud.shiftLift: Back on the lift. Good shift!
hud.flood: Water is pouring into the tunnels!
hud.oreStolen: A thief took some ore! Catch it!
hud.thiefEscaped: The thief got away with the ore.
hud.bossDefeated: The Mole King falls! The lift is free.
hud.exitJammed: The Mole King jams the lift!
hud.playerRevived: A miner is back on their feet!
hud.reviving: Hold dig next to a downed friend to get them up.

results.noteLift: The lift brought everyone and the ore back up.
results.noteDark: The lamps went out. The ore stayed behind.
results.noteAllDown: No miner was left standing. The ore stayed behind.
results.noteVictory: The lift carries the brigade home. The mine is yours.
results.nextBoss: Next: {stratum}, floor {floor} - the Mole King waits
results.retryFloor: To the camp, then try again
results.copiedSession: Code {code} kept for this session only: this build has no system clipboard, so write it down.

join.title: Who is digging?
join.slotEmpty: {player}: press A (gamepad) or Enter (keyboard) to join
join.hint: A / Enter: join.   B / Esc: leave (or go back to the title).   The first player presses Start / Enter to begin. Up to 4 players: a keyboard and three gamepads, or four gamepads.

pads.handOver: Press A on another controller (or Enter on the keyboard) to give {player}'s miner to it.
pads.drop: Or another player presses Y (Backspace on the keyboard) to drop {player} from the shift.

camp.title: The camp
camp.hint: Spend your cash on upgrades, then go down.
camp.copiedSession: Code {code} kept for this session only: this build has no system clipboard, so write it down.

slots.title: Choose a slot
slots.confirm: Delete slot {slot}? This cannot be undone.

synced.unavailable: This build has no cloud saves.
synced.inSync: Slots and cloud are the same.
synced.downloaded: Slot {slot} came down from the cloud.
synced.conflict: Slot {slot} was changed in two places: the one with more play time won ({winner}); the other is kept as a backup.

slots.storageDamaged: The save folder was damaged; the game kept a copy and started empty. Sync with the cloud may bring your slots back.
slots.imported: Your old save is now slot {slot}.
slots.legacy: An old save could not be imported: {message}. {hint}.

code.title: Seed code
code.prompt: Type or paste a mine code, like {example}
code.pasteEmpty: Nothing to paste yet: copy a code first, or type it.

first_ore.name: First Strike
first_ore.description: Dig up your first piece of ore.

bright_stratum.name: Lamps Lit
bright_stratum.description: Clear the last floor of a stratum without a single lamp going out in it.

full_house.name: Full House
full_house.description: Finish a shift on the lift with 4 miners.

boards.title: Boards
boards.empty: No scores yet. Bank some ore on the lift!
boards.unavailable: The boards are not available here.
boards.dailyNote: The board of {date}. Start a daily dig from the camp to post here.
boards.dailySkipped: The daily dig crossed midnight: its score was not posted to today's board.

presence.resultsLift: Back on the lift after shift {shift}

online.consentBody: Help improve the game by sending when a shift ends, which floor you reach and when you quit. No name, no device, nothing you typed. You can change this in Options.

textEntry.keyboard: Type the code, then press Enter.
